# ankra_pipeline_workspace_profiles (Resource)

The workspace profiles of a pipeline repository (`ankra pipeline workspace-profiles put`): for each workspace kind, the image, size, setup steps, tools and service sidecars an AI workspace of that kind runs. The resource owns the repository's whole set and replaces it on every change; the platform validates each profile as a workspace would be rendered from it. A running workspace picks a change up at its next bring-up. Managing profiles needs `workspaces.manage`. Destroy clears the profiles, so workspaces take their image from the repository's pipeline again.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "ankra_pipeline_workspace_profiles" "web" {
  repository_id = ankra_pipeline_repository.web.id
  profiles_json = jsonencode({
    default = {
      image       = "ghcr.io/acme/workspace:1.4.0"
      volume_size = "20Gi"
      resources   = { cpu = "2", memory = "4Gi" }
      setup       = ["make deps"]
    }
  })
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `profiles_json` (String, Sensitive) The profiles as a JSON object keyed by workspace kind, each with `image`, `resources` (`cpu`, `memory`), `volume_size`, `setup`, `tools` and `services`. Write it with `jsonencode`. Marked sensitive: service sidecars carry environment variables.
- `repository_id` (String) Identifier of the pipeline repository. Changing it replaces the resource.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The repository id.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Imported by pipeline repository id.
terraform import ankra_pipeline_workspace_profiles.web 2c4e6a8b-1d3f-4a5b-8c7d-9e0f1a2b3c4d
```
